proposed.text: A C-2 commercial lot is 1,000 sqm with FLAR limit 12.0, BHL 50 m, 3.0 m floor-to-floor height, and a problem-stated AMBF of 750 sqm. How many complete floors fit both constraints?

options.text: 16 floors: BHL gives 16 full floors and 16 x 750 = 12,000 sqm, exactly at FLAR 12.0
14 floors because C-2 lots always use a lower national FLAR
8 floors because both constraints always halve the BHL result

proposed.rationale: BHL permits floor(50/3) = 16 full floors. With the problem-stated AMBF of 750 sqm, 16 floors produce 12,000 sqm TGFA, which equals the stated FLAR cap of 1,000 x 12.0.
proposed.explanation: Use the problem-stated local zoning values. Do not present the C-2 PSO/FLAR numbers as a universal national value unless the local ordinance is cited.
proposed.code_citation: PD 1096 Rule VII/VIII; LGU zoning input stated in item
